name: Vembu family (Sridhar Vembu and siblings)
note: Forbes: founder Sridhar Vembu and his two siblings own a majority stake in privately held Zoho. A 2026 divorce-case report (News18) quotes Vembu's attorney saying Vembu personally holds 5% of Zoho Corporation Pvt Ltd; the majority-stake picture is contested between the two reports.
